project.name: telezart-fubuki
project.description: Telezart stock car: minimal Debian trixie, systemd, serial console, built to boot in QEMU at 128 MiB for the higher-level kmalloc-family trace capture (actual byte requests) that feeds the Iscandar replay. Iscandar variant: the same car linked to the Iscandar RAM system for the Paper 3 evidence boot.

finetuning.file: #!/bin/sh # Telezart trace capture (runtime activation only) set -e mount -t tracefs tracefs /sys/kernel/tracing 2>/dev/null || true cd /sys/kernel/tracing cat /proc/buddyinfo > /root/counters-before.txt cat /proc/pagetypeinfo >> /root/counters-before.txt cat /proc/vmstat >> /root/counters-before.txt cat /proc/meminfo >> /root/counters-before.txt dd if=/proc/kpageflags of=/root/kpageflags-before.bin bs=8 status=none for e in kmalloc kmalloc_node kmem_cache_alloc kmem_cache_alloc_node kfree kmem_cache_free; do if [ -e events/kmem/$e/enable ]; then echo 1 > events/kmem/$e/enable; fi; done echo "capture on: trace running to /root/telezart-trace.txt" echo "stop with: telezart-stop (or kill the cat, then sync)" cat trace_pipe > /root/telezart-trace.txt &

#!/bin/sh # Telezart trace stop: disable events, snapshot counters, sync cd /sys/kernel/tracing 2>/dev/null || exit 0 for e in kmalloc kmalloc_node kmem_cache_alloc kmem_cache_alloc_node kfree kmem_cache_free; do if [ -e events/kmem/$e/enable ]; then echo 0 > events/kmem/$e/enable; fi; done cat trace > /root/telezart-trace-boot.txt pkill -f "cat trace_pipe" || true cat /proc/buddyinfo > /root/counters-after.txt cat /proc/pagetypeinfo >> /root/counters-after.txt cat /proc/vmstat >> /root/counters-after.txt cat /proc/meminfo >> /root/counters-after.txt dd if=/proc/kpageflags of=/root/kpageflags-after.bin bs=8 status=none sync echo "capture stopped; trace and counters are in /root"

#!/bin/sh # Telezart finish: stop the trace, count everything, and walk # the results out the virtio door into the host share folder, so # nobody has to mount and unmount the disk image ever again. telezart-stop || true telezart-stats || true modprobe 9pnet_virtio 2>/dev/null || true mkdir -p /mnt/tzshare if mount -t 9p -o trans=virtio,version=9p2000.L tzshare /mnt/tzshare 2>/dev/null; then cp /root/telezart-trace-boot.txt /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /root/telezart-trace.txt /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /root/telezart-stats.txt /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /root/counters-before.txt /root/counters-after.txt /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /root/kpageflags-before.bin /root/kpageflags-after.bin /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true sync umount /mnt/tzshare echo "telezart: results exported to the host share" else echo "telezart: no host share mounted; results remain in /root" fi

[Unit] Description=Telezart automatic trace stop at login readiness DefaultDependencies=no After=local-fs.target Before=multi-user.target
[Service] Type=oneshot ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/telezart-finish
[Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target

# iscandar-build.conf -- GENERATED from build/bridge/iscandar_bridge.h # by build/gen-build-conf.sh. Do not hand-edit; the link-check diffs it. ISCANDAR_PAGE_BYTES=4096 ISCANDAR_CUBE_PAGES=32768 ISCANDAR_ARENA_CUBES=4 ISCANDAR_ARENA_PAGES=131072 ISCANDAR_ARENA_BYTES=536870912 ISCANDAR_FIXTURE_PAGES_TOTAL=84 ISCANDAR_NET_SERVED_PAGES=130988 ISCANDAR_REGISTRY_CAP=512 ISCANDAR_REGISTRY_PAGES=8 ISCANDAR_CHANNEL_PAGES=128 ISCANDAR_CHANNEL_BYTES=524288 ISCANDAR_LAYER_RESERVE_PAGES=160

#!/bin/sh # Iscandar payload install (first boot). The ELBE finetuning # carries text (units, scripts, the constants file) into the # image; the two compiled payloads ride the host share, the # same door the kernel and initrd already come through in # the Fubuki arrangement. This script installs them before # the translation layer's unit can start. A missing payload # is a loud failure on the console, never a quiet boot # without the stack. modprobe 9pnet_virtio 2>/dev/null || true mkdir -p /mnt/tzshare if ! mount -t 9p -o trans=virtio,version=9p2000.L tzshare /mnt/tzshare 2>/dev/null; then echo "iscandar-payload: host share not mounted; the Iscandar payload is missing" exit 1 fi ok=1 for f in iscandar-layer iscandar-exerciser; do if [ -f "/mnt/tzshare/iscandar-payload/$f" ]; then install -m 0755 "/mnt/tzshare/iscandar-payload/$f" "/usr/local/sbin/$f" else echo "iscandar-payload: $f missing from the share's iscandar-payload folder" ok=0 fi done umount /mnt/tzshare [ "$ok" = 1 ] || exit 1 echo "iscandar-payload: installed iscandar-layer and iscandar-exerciser"

[Unit] Description=Iscandar payload install from the host share DefaultDependencies=no After=local-fs.target Before=iscandar-layer.service
[Service] Type=oneshot ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/iscandar-payload-install StandardOutput=journal+console StandardError=journal+console
[Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit] Description=Iscandar translation layer (Paper 3 live build) After=iscandar-payload.service local-fs.target Before=iscandar-exerciser.service ConditionPathExists=/usr/local/sbin/iscandar-layer
[Service] Type=simple ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /run/iscandar /var/log/iscandar ExecStartPre=/bin/rm -f /run/iscandar/channel.bin ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/iscandar-layer --serve /run/iscandar/channel.bin StandardOutput=journal+console StandardError=journal+console Restart=no
[Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit] Description=Open the kernel bridge to the raised layer After=iscandar-layer.service Before=iscandar-exerciser.service
[Service] Type=oneshot ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'for i in $(seq 1 50); do if grep -q "state ready" /proc/iscandar_bridge 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; echo raise > /proc/iscandar_bridge 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 0.2; done; echo "iscandar-raise: the bridge did not come up" >&2; exit 1' StandardOutput=journal+console StandardError=journal+console
[Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit] Description=Iscandar page exerciser (Paper 3 evidence run) Documentation=file:/usr/local/share/doc/iscandar-exerciser/README.md After=multi-user.target # The evidence rig's finish service (trace export and shutdown) # orders itself After=iscandar-exerciser.service.
[Service] Type=oneshot ExecStartPre=/bin/mkdir -p /var/log/iscandar-exerciser ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/iscandar-exerciser StandardInput=tty TTYPath=/dev/console StandardOutput=journal+console StandardError=journal+console TimeoutStartSec=0
[Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target

#!/bin/sh # Iscandar finish: stop the layer, harvest the run's books, # run the stock Telezart stop and stats, and export # everything through the 9p share, mirroring telezart-finish # with the Iscandar harvest added in front of the same door. # The patched image does not enable telezart-autostop: its # multi-user timing predates the exerciser in the evidence # boot, so this script is the finish step, and the unit # powers the guest off after it. CHAN=/run/iscandar/channel.bin # The stop word: offset 264 in the channel file, fixed by the # shared header's control layout; the layer carries a # compile-time assertion on the offset. if [ -f "$CHAN" ]; then printf '\001\000\000\000' | dd of="$CHAN" bs=1 seek=264 count=4 conv=notrunc status=none fi for i in $(seq 1 50); do pgrep -x iscandar-layer >/dev/null || break sleep 0.2 done mkdir -p /root/iscandar-results cp /var/log/iscandar/layer-ledger.txt /root/iscandar-results/ 2>/dev/null || true cp iscandar-layer-ledger.txt /root/iscandar-results/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /var/log/iscandar-exerciser/ledger.txt /root/iscandar-results/exerciser-ledger.txt 2>/dev/null || true cp "$CHAN" /root/iscandar-results/channel-snapshot.bin 2>/dev/null || true cat /proc/iscandar_bridge > /root/iscandar-results/proc-iscandar-bridge.txt 2>/dev/null || true cp /usr/local/share/iscandar/iscandar-build.conf /root/iscandar-results/ 2>/dev/null || true telezart-stop || true telezart-stats || true modprobe 9pnet_virtio 2>/dev/null || true mkdir -p /mnt/tzshare if mount -t 9p -o trans=virtio,version=9p2000.L tzshare /mnt/tzshare 2>/dev/null; then cp /root/telezart-trace-boot.txt /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /root/telezart-trace.txt /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /root/telezart-stats.txt /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /root/counters-before.txt /root/counters-after.txt /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp /root/kpageflags-before.bin /root/kpageflags-after.bin /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true cp -r /root/iscandar-results /mnt/tzshare/ 2>/dev/null || true sync umount /mnt/tzshare echo "iscandar-finish: results exported to the host share" else echo "iscandar-finish: no host share mounted; results remain in /root" fi

[Unit] Description=Iscandar finish: export the evidence, then shut down After=iscandar-exerciser.service
[Service] Type=oneshot ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/iscandar-finish ExecStart=/bin/systemctl poweroff StandardOutput=journal+console StandardError=journal+console TimeoutStartSec=0
[Install] WantedBy=multi-user.target
finetuning.command: mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants && cd /etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants && ln -sf ../iscandar-payload.service . && ln -sf ../iscandar-layer.service . && ln -sf ../iscandar-raise.service . && ln -sf ../iscandar-exerciser.service . && ln -sf ../iscandar-finish.service .
